title: Biostrap Recovery Score Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=biostrap:daily
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(user_id) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Biostrap recovery score events land each day and how many distinct user values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Biostrap recovery score records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct user values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your how much Biostrap recovery score activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
